cases.sql: SELECT id,v FROM facts WHERE g < 4 AND v >= 8000 ORDER BY id
SELECT id,k,g,v FROM facts ORDER BY id
SELECT g,COUNT(*),COUNT(v),SUM(v) FROM facts GROUP BY g ORDER BY g
SELECT k,COUNT(*),COUNT(v),SUM(v) AS s FROM facts GROUP BY k ORDER BY s DESC,k LIMIT 32
SELECT d.g,COUNT(*),COUNT(f.v),SUM(f.v) FROM facts f JOIN facts d ON f.k=d.k WHERE d.id < 125 AND MOD(d.id,7) <> 0 GROUP BY d.g ORDER BY d.g
SELECT g,COUNT(DISTINCT v) FROM facts GROUP BY g ORDER BY g
SELECT id,v FROM facts ORDER BY v DESC,id LIMIT 32
SELECT id,SUM(v) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS 255 PRECEDING),COUNT(v) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS 255 PRECEDING),MIN(v) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS 255 PRECEDING) FROM facts ORDER BY id

SELECT id,(CASE WHEN v IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE k END) IN (SELECT CASE WHEN v IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE k END FROM facts WHERE MOD(id,3)=0), (CASE WHEN v IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE k END) NOT IN (SELECT CASE WHEN v IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE k END FROM facts WHERE MOD(id,3)=0) FROM facts ORDER BY id
SELECT o.id,o.k,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM facts i WHERE i.k=o.k),(SELECT COUNT(v) FROM facts i WHERE i.k=o.k),(SELECT SUM(v) FROM facts i WHERE i.k=o.k) FROM facts o ORDER BY o.id LIMIT 128
